raw_resume.summary: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate (2025) who builds full-stack web applications with Java, Spring Boot and React. Seeking a Software Development Engineer role to apply expertise in scalable systems and object-oriented design.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed a Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and eliminated double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status, deployed locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Data Structures and Algorithms through competitive programming or LeetCode; the JD emphasises these as core competencies.
Study Distributed Systems concepts (eventual consistency, consensus, partitioning, replication) and implement a small project demonstrating these principles.
Deepen Object-Oriented Design knowledge by refactoring your projects to showcase design patterns (Factory, Observer, Strategy) and SOLID principles in your code.
Build a project that explicitly tackles scalability challenges, such as a rate-limited API gateway or a multi-threaded cache, to demonstrate real-time systems thinking.
raw_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals, but the JD prioritises Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems and Object-Oriented Design—none of which are evident in your current profile. Gaining these will significantly strengthen your candidacy.
